title: Create Compelling Spectacles
hook: The empty chair at the gala says more than Charles's donor speech ever could.
counterintuition: Power often hides in the setup, not the speech. Here the better choice is to shape spectacle before the visible contest begins.
tryThisNow: Before the next relevant conversation, write the one pressure word in play: spectacle. Then choose the smallest visible action that changes it.
keyTakeaway: Turn meaning into image and arrangement so memory grasps it before explanation fades.

ifThenPlans.plan: If a work decision exposes spectacle, then change the first visible artifact or sequence before making the argument.
